values.description: llama-swap reached directly, not through Firecrawl. run.sh derives it from OPENAI_BASE_URL in .env (dropping the /v1 the OpenAI SDK appends), so leave it blank unless you run newman by hand - in which case set it to something like http://localhost:8081.
OpenCode Zen host root, no /v1 - the /v1/systemone path is appended by the request itself. run.sh derives it from TYPESAFE_BASE_URL in .env. Leave blank unless running newman by hand.
Secret. Read from .env.prod by run.sh; never committed. Jev is optional for Firecrawl, so this one is not required - without it the Jev requests fail with 401.
Model name sent in the request body. run.sh derives it from TYPESAFE_MODEL in .env; the default here only applies when running newman by hand.
